question_text: Outline two benefits of reusing a tested library function through its documented interface rather than reimplementing it at every call site.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Reuse reduces repeated development effort. A well-tested shared implementation can reduce duplicated defects and can be replaced centrally through the same interface, although its suitability still needs checking.

marking_points.criterion: Explains reliability or central update benefit without treating all libraries as infallible.
